ShortDescription.Value: A building lens inside the vanilla build menus: table, grid and list views with facets, metric ranges and a coverage overlay.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Better Building Menu
A building lens for Cities: Skylines II. Open any vanilla build menu and the lens takes its place, showing the same buildings the game would — the game's own menu tree decides what belongs — as a table, a grid or a list you can sort, group and search.
Narrow the set with facets (availability, source, theme, pack, placement, role) and with metric ranges (cost, upkeep, workers, capacity, lot size). A search that finds nothing inside a menu can widen itself to every menu.
Hover a building for its numbers; place one and a coverage overlay shows what it reaches. The picker (Ctrl+P) opens the lens on a building already in the city.
Derived from Find It 1.5.8 by T. D. W. This is not a replacement for Find It: it lists buildings and networks only, and leaves props, trees and detailing to the mods made for them.
